description: ESPN standings for NBA, NFL, MLB or NHL, by conference or division group as ESPN lists them: team, wins, losses, win percentage, games behind and streak, from ESPN's public standings JSON. Current season as ESPN serves it. Related tools on this server, for a different need: dev_espn_mlb_scoreboard when you need ESPN MLB scoreboard for one date: every game with away; dev_espn_nba_scoreboard when you need ESPN NBA scoreboard for one date: every game with away. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: dev_espn_standings
title: ESPN standings for NBA, NFL, MLB or NHL, by conference
